market_summary.trend: BTC at ~$64,750. Pulled back slightly from Jul 15 high of $65,100 after softer CPI (Jul 14) triggered rally. Up ~10% in July from June lows (~$60k). Still -30% from Jan 2026 highs above $93k.
market_summary.sentiment: Fear & Greed Index ~26 (Fear territory). Price recovering but sentiment remains fearful - cautious divergence. Fragile recovery phase.
market_summary.macro: Jun CPI (Jul 14): softer than expected at 3.5% YoY - main bullish catalyst for current recovery. PPI declined 0.3% MoM (below 6.2% forecast). Fed funds rate at 3.63%. FOMC hold expected Jul 28-29.
market_summary.etf_flows: Spot BTC ETFs: $4.13B net outflows over 30 days, but small $10M inflow recently ending multi-day outflow streak. Structural headwind but showing signs of stabilization.
market_summary.onchain: 326 WBTC withdrawn from ETH exchanges Jul 15 (largest net outflow since early June) - potential accumulation signal. Taiwan lawmaker: 80% chance of national BTC holdings within 5 years.
market_summary.regulatory: Goldman Sachs filed for new BTC ETF. SEC generic listing standards approved for crypto ETPs - shortens approval timelines from 240d to ~75d. Regulatory environment improving.
